baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated بَلَوْنَا at words 2 and 4 governs the owners of the garden and their sworn dawn harvest at words 5-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile presents a trial as disclosure through an owned environment: sustained attachment to a covered source of abundance, followed by an oath, harvest, and chosen dawn threshold, supplies the apparatus by which the claimants' state becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Testing that discloses a person's or deed's condition supplies the governing revelatory function of both trials.
Sustained companionship or possession makes the people legible through their durable attachment to the garden.
The tree-covered orchard supplies the enclosed material field in which the owners' disposition is tested.
The oath image turns an intention into a collectively asserted commitment.
Palm and crop harvesting supplies the concrete act through which the sworn claim will be enacted.
Dawn supplies the narrow temporal threshold selected for the revealing action.

changed_reading.before: A present group is simply punished by analogy with earlier garden owners.
changed_reading.after: A possessed and covered abundance, a binding oath, a harvest, and a dawn deadline form a disclosure machine: the trial makes the owners visible through what they plan to do with what accompanies them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first word-pair بَلَوْنَاهُمْ / بَلَوْنَا is immediately instantiated by a flourishing جَنَّة and its owners.
baseline_models.mechanism: One live branch of ب ل و is beautiful benefaction rather than adversity. Coupled with abundant plant growth, this makes the granted garden the initial trial, while loss can remain a later disclosure rather than the whole meaning of trial.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction and excellent giving make the good bestowed on the owners, not only a later hardship, trial-bearing material.
Thick, intertwined, abundant growth supplies the positive surplus whose handling reveals the owners.
Possession and lasting association locate the trial in the owners' relation to a benefit already with them.

changed_reading.before: The trial begins when disaster strikes the garden.
changed_reading.after: The garden's flourishing is already the trial as benefaction; disaster later exposes how its owners received and intended to use the good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated trial verb encloses a clause whose decisive human action is أَقْسَمُوا, followed by emphatic لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped inventory for ب ل و itself contains offering an oath for reassurance or testing. Its contact with explicit oath-taking and decisive execution makes the oath internal to the trial: their self-certification becomes evidence about them.

activation_trace.role: Offering an oath to reassure or test supplies a live bridge from trial to the speakers' self-assuring pledge.
Actual oath-taking realizes that bridge as the owners' chosen speech act.
Firm resolve and forceful execution show what the oath claims to guarantee.

changed_reading.before: The oath merely reports how confident the owners were about harvesting.
changed_reading.after: The oath is itself test material: by using pledged certainty to reassure themselves, the owners expose the condition the trial is meant to disclose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَصْحَاب names a plural association, while أَقْسَمُوا and لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا place apportionment and severing images inside its common plan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath root also carries division into shares, while the harvest root carries cutting and separation. The collective therefore plans to convert one covered living whole into controlled, severed portions; the verse can test a distributional relation, not just work discipline.

activation_trace.role: Company and possession supply the plural association that jointly controls the resource.
Dividing and assigning shares supplies a distributive underside to the explicit oath form.
Cutting, separation, and rupture turn distribution into a material severance from the whole.
The enclosed orchard supplies the living whole they mean to convert into portions.

changed_reading.before: The owners schedule an ordinary collective harvest.
changed_reading.after: Their oath projects a social operation: turn one enclosed abundance into severed and apportioned holdings under the companions' control.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic oath, forceful harvest verb, and مُصْبِحِينَ converge at the end of the ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The morning root includes the morning raid, while the harvest root includes forceful resolve. This permits an exploratory reading in which the owners approach their own garden as a target to be seized at dawn, intensifying urgency beyond neutral farm scheduling.

activation_trace.role: The dawn raid and its alarm supply an aggressive temporal image for going out in the morning.
Decisive resolve and forceful execution give the planned harvest raid-like momentum.
The shared oath coordinates the group before the dawn action.
The enclosed orchard becomes the raid's surprising object rather than an enemy settlement.

changed_reading.before: Morning is only a practical harvest time.
changed_reading.after: Morning carries raid energy: the owners mobilize against their own abundance as though speed and seizure were needed before daylight opens other claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier assay image sharpens trial-as-disclosure: what is covered in the owners is made legible under pressure, as material composition becomes evident in an assay.

activation_trace.role: Testing and disclosure provide the focus model that the context assay sharpens.
Covering and concealment supply the hidden condition that needs manifestation.
Assaying metal and testing a person supplies a pressure-to-manifest image for the garden trial.

structural_cues: 68:6 places مَفْتُونُ before the garden comparison, introducing assay vocabulary before its narrative instance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, concealment, and metal-or-human assay; I transfer the material arrow from pressure to revealed composition onto the owners' conduct. A live alternative is that مَفْتُونُ only labels an afflicted or disputed person here.

changed_reading.before: Testing checks whether the owners will behave rightly.
changed_reading.after: Testing acts as an assay that externalizes a previously covered social composition; the issue is manifestation under pressure, not information newly acquired by the tester.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promise of reward whose extension is not cut off forms a material contrast with the focus's harvest-severing. The owners organize good around a terminal cut, while the prior reward image resists exhaustion and termination.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and diminishing until extension ends supplies the negated image behind reward that is not cut off.
Severing and discontinuity make the owners' intended relation to their good a positive economy of cutoff.
Apportioning shares explains how the finite good is to be bounded after cutting.

structural_cues: 68:3's غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ precedes 68:17's emphatic لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا, placing uncut extension before intended severance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated cutoff image and a focus severance image; I read their sequence as a contrast between two economies of good. The alternative is that the earlier phrase only asserts duration and does not comment on the garden owners.

changed_reading.before: Harvesting is an isolated agricultural act.
changed_reading.after: The harvest enacts a finite, cutoff model of good, set against an earlier reward characterized precisely by the failure of extension to be cut.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence joins habitual oath-taking to withholding beneficial good. When the garden owners then swear, their oath can function as coalition discipline around non-giving, not merely as emphatic confidence.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath supplies the speech act whose social function is revised by the earlier profile.
Oath and swearing establish oath-use as morally inspectable rather than automatically trustworthy.
Holding one's hand back from giving supplies the concrete social aim that the garden oath can coordinate.
Beneficial good identifies what is withheld and connects the moral profile to garden abundance.

structural_cues: 68:10-12 presents oath-taking and prevention of good in one uninterrupted character profile before the garden comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the oath/prevention sequence and the owners' oath; I infer that their oath polices a shared withholding plan. The alternative is that the earlier profile addresses a separate person and supplies only thematic resonance.

changed_reading.before: The owners swear because they are certain the crop is ready.
changed_reading.after: Their oath is a social instrument that binds companions to a non-giving use of abundance, activating the earlier oath-taker who withholds good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel identifies the missing operation as exception: their oath folds no alternative, dependency, or excluded case back into its claimed future. The trial exposes certainty made linguistically closed.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the future claim that could have been qualified.
Decisive execution supplies the closed certainty projected by the oath.
Exception as removing something from a total names the qualification their plan does not permit.

structural_cues: 68:18 follows the sworn harvest without a subject change and negates their making an exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies oath, decisive resolve, and absent exception; I infer that closure itself is trial-bearing. A live alternative is that the omission is only a missing formula, not a broader refusal of contingency.

changed_reading.before: The oath is unusually emphatic confidence.
changed_reading.after: The oath attempts to close the future against exception; the owners are disclosed by the refusal to leave any dependency or competing claim inside their plan.

context_deltas.mechanism: While the owners rest in trusting stillness, an encircling visitor acts. At morning the focus pair 'harvest in the morning' returns as 'it became like al-sarim': becoming replaces their intended action, and the garden receives the cut-state before they can impose it.

activation_trace.role: The planned dawn supplies the temporal boundary at which the reversal will become visible.
Intended crop-cutting supplies the active predicate that is turned back onto the garden.
A passing or sudden visitor supplies the counter-agent that intervenes before dawn.
Resting trust in something supplies the owners' unavailable and overconfident state during the counter-action.
Becoming a state converts the owners' morning action into the garden's already-completed condition.
Al-sarim as night, dawn, or a blackened cutoff state keeps both temporal darkness and severance live in the reversal.

structural_cues: 68:17 projects owners as agents of صرم at morning; 68:19-20 makes them sleepers and the garden the subject of becoming صريم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated morning/cut roots and the subject shift; I infer a transfer of the planned predicate from owners to garden. The materially live alternative is that صريم primarily paints night-like blackness rather than a harvested condition, so darkness and cutting should coexist.

changed_reading.before: A calamity merely prevents the intended harvest.
changed_reading.after: The plan is formally returned to its makers: by their chosen morning, their object has already become the cut-off or night-dark state they meant to produce, reversing agent, patient, and timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath unfolds as an access-control operation: move early, lower speech, prevent entry, target the socially immobilized person, and proceed in a contracted state of prevention. Harvest timing is therefore a gate around participation in abundance.

activation_trace.role: The shared oath coordinates the later operational sequence.
Severing supplies both crop removal and the social cutoff enacted around it.
Secret, lowered speech makes concealment an operational feature rather than incidental mood.
Entry into an interior supplies the boundary they intend to close.
The abasement of poverty identifies the person whose restricted mobility and claim the timing exploits.
Prevention and contraction supply the group's narrowed, exclusionary operating posture.

structural_cues: 68:23-25 sequences whispering, no entry today, and movement in a state of حرد immediately after the morning summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secrecy, barred entry, poverty, and prevention; I infer that early harvesting is chosen to defeat another person's practical claim. The alternative is opportunistic avoidance of a request rather than denial of a recognized legal share.

changed_reading.before: The companions simply want the crop gathered efficiently at dawn.
changed_reading.after: Dawn is a social gate: the oath synchronizes secrecy and speed so the harvest can be severed before a vulnerable entrant can participate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people who schedule another's non-entry name themselves with deprivation after seeing the garden. The trial makes them inhabit the very relation to good that their cutting plan attempted to assign elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure through trial makes the rebound reveal, rather than merely hurt, the owners.
Severance supplies the relation to access that changes sides.
Deprivation and failure to attain the desired thing name the owners' resulting position.

structural_cues: The no-entry plan of 68:24 is followed by the owners' self-description نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ in 68:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intended exclusion and resulting deprivation; I infer a role reversal in which the planners experience their own social verb. The alternative is simple crop loss without measure-for-measure symmetry.

changed_reading.before: The owners' loss is an external interruption of their plan.
changed_reading.after: The loss returns the plan's relation upon them: those arranging another's deprivation discover themselves as the deprived.

context_deltas.mechanism: The companions first assemble through a morning call and common oath, then become partitioned parts facing and blaming one another. Trial discloses the durability of companionship by converting coordinated speech into reciprocal accusation.

activation_trace.role: Sustained company supplies the social bond being tested.
Their mutual oath supplies the initial speech that binds the group.
The council or gathering of a group supplies their coordinated morning assembly.
Partition into parts turns the companions into opposed fractions of their former coalition.
Mutual blame replaces the oath's common voice with reciprocal accusation.

structural_cues: The group moves from calling one another in 68:21 to one part confronting another in 68:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, partition, and blame; I infer that companionship itself is one object of the trial. The alternative is a temporary dispute that leaves their underlying association intact.

changed_reading.before: أَصْحَاب merely labels several co-owners.
changed_reading.after: Their companionship is tested as a bond: it coordinates exclusion while success seems certain, then splits into blaming parts when control fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trial's disclosure is not only terminal exposure. A just middle voice, exoneration of the Lord, acknowledgment of withholding right, hope for substitution, and redirected desire trace a possible movement after disclosure without guaranteeing its completion.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals condition supplies the process whose result may become acknowledged and redirected.
Justice and excellence in the middle position supply an internal corrective voice within the group.
Exoneration and declaring transcendence redirect blame away from the Lord.
Withholding or confining someone from a right gives their admission a specific social content.
One thing standing in place of another supplies hope that the lost arrangement need not be final.
Desire turning toward or away supplies the directional reorientation produced after confession.

structural_cues: 68:28-32 moves from an internal warning through confession and mutual blame to stated desire toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correction, confession, substitution, and redirected desire; I infer a possible transformative phase of trial after exposure. The alternative is remorse and wish without durable repair, so the reading remains processual rather than acquittal.

changed_reading.before: The trial exposes a fixed bad character and closes the case.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure can initiate reorientation inside the same companions: recognition and redirected desire become a second phase of trial, though the text does not certify completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same garden image later joins protection and delight. A garden is therefore not self-interpreting as reward or punishment; covered abundance can be a revealing benefaction in the focus and protected enjoyment in another relation.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction as trial makes the focus garden good that can nevertheless reveal its recipients.
The covered orchard supplies the materially identical image whose ethical valence can vary.
Good condition and blessing make the later gardens explicit sites of delight.
The repeated tree-covered garden image creates the direct material comparison with the focus garden.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the contrasting relation under which garden abundance remains delight.

structural_cues: 68:34 repeats جَنَّات immediately after the garden episode but attaches them to the protected and to delight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated garden, blessing, and protection images; I infer that recipient relation, not the object alone, controls valence. The alternative is that the later gardens are wholly eschatological and only loosely contrast with the earthly orchard.

changed_reading.before: Garden abundance is either an uncomplicated reward or merely scenery for punishment.
changed_reading.after: The same covered abundance can be benefaction-as-test or protected delight; the focus tests the relation formed around the garden rather than condemning the garden itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions join judgment, a writing that obligates, and far-reaching oaths guaranteeing whatever is judged. This activates the focus oath as counterfeit jurisdiction: the owners speak as if their apportionment can obligate the future.

activation_trace.role: Their explicit oath supplies the attempted binding instrument.
Apportionment supplies the outcome over which the owners implicitly claim authority.
Judgment between people makes the issue one of authority to decide, not only prediction.
A written fixation that imposes judgment or decree supplies the missing warrant for a binding future claim.
Oaths explicitly supply the imagined guarantee by which desired judgment would be secured.
Reaching the limit extends the imagined oath's force all the way to its asserted horizon.
The repeated judgment image states the claimed result: having whatever they themselves decide.

structural_cues: 68:36-39 asks how they judge, whether a book warrants it, and whether binding oaths guarantee whatever they judge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus oath and the later oath/book/judgment challenge; I map the challenge backward so the garden oath appears jurisdictional. The alternative is a separate polemic whose legal vocabulary only analogically illuminates the owners.

changed_reading.before: The oath predicts a harvest the owners expect to perform.
changed_reading.after: The oath performs an unauthorized judgment: it treats their desired apportionment as though pledged speech could place the future under their jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question about possessing the unseen and writing it recasts the sworn morning as epistemic authorship. The owners do not only choose an hour; their unqualified oath writes unseen conditions as settled fact.

activation_trace.role: The oath gives spoken certainty to a future event not yet visible.
The coming dawn supplies the unseen time the owners treat as already controlled.
Writing and ordered letters supply the image of authoring a future claim.
What is covered from sight identifies the epistemic domain their oath presumes to settle.

structural_cues: 68:47 directly couples possession of the unseen with writing, while 68:17 couples oath with a specified future morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future certainty, hidden-from-sight reality, and writing; I infer that the owners act as authors of unseen conditions. The alternative is ordinary planning, with the later question aimed only at a broader audience's claims.

changed_reading.before: Naming morning is practical scheduling.
changed_reading.after: Naming morning inside an exceptionless oath is an attempt to author the unseen, treating future conditions as text already in the owners' possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gradual taking, extended time, counter-planning, and sustained solidity make delay part of the trial's mechanism. The owners' short dawn clock sits inside a longer interval that permits certainty to consolidate before reversal.

activation_trace.role: Trial and disclosure supply the focus process whose temporal mechanism is expanded.
The owners' selected dawn supplies their short, apparently controlled horizon.
Taking by degrees supplies a trial that unfolds through stages rather than one isolated blow.
Extension and respite in time make apparent non-intervention an active part of the mechanism.
Counter-planning supplies a larger design within which the owners' plan is allowed to ripen.
Extended solidity gives the counter-plan durable reach beyond the owners' narrow deadline.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 pairs gradual drawing-on with respite and a firm counter-plan after the garden episode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged taking, temporal extension, and strong planning; I project that temporal logic back onto the garden trial. The alternative is that these later warnings address different rejectors and do not specify how the garden event was timed.

changed_reading.before: The test is the single nighttime destruction that surprises the owners.
changed_reading.after: The granted interval in which their oath hardens is already part of the test; their dawn deadline is nested inside a slower counter-timing that lets hidden character become actionable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the opening pen root activates a lot-stick and a cut section of land, while the writing root activates a line of striking or cutting; it remains anchored in the focus's apportioning oath, orchard, and severing verb. Downstream prose should present it as a material echo of allotment and inscription, not claim that qalam literally denotes a garden survey in 68:1.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَقْسَمُوا and لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا place allotment and cutting around the garden that the opening pen/cut images can unexpectedly activate.

activation_trace.role: A trimmed stick cast as a lot supplies a material procedure for converting uncertainty into an assigned outcome.
A cut section of land supplies the startling land-allotment image that contacts the garden plan.
A line made by striking or cutting supplies inscription as a material cut rather than only abstract writing.
Division into shares anchors the lot and cut-land images in the focus's own root field.
Severing anchors the writing-line image in the intended physical act.
The orchard supplies the land and produce over which the imagined allotment is made.

changed_reading.before: The owners verbally promise to harvest land they already possess.
changed_reading.after: Their oath acts like a lot already cast and a cut line already inscribed: they materially pre-allot the garden's future before the future arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The later criminal root unexpectedly contains both cutting/harvest and dry harvest remnants, directly contacting ص ر م. This remains valid as a lexical shadow anchored in the focus's harvest verb and the later Muslim/criminal contrast, but prose must not infer that harvesting itself is criminal; the ethical force concerns the severing relation enacted here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا names the intended harvest whose cutting image is reactivated inside مُجْرِمِينَ at 68:35.

activation_trace.role: Crop harvesting supplies the focus action that receives the later lexical shadow.
Severing and rupture identify the specific aspect of harvest that the criminal-root branches echo.
Cutting and crop severance place a harvest image inside the root used for criminals.
Dry remnants left from harvest extend the echo from the act of cutting to its residue.

changed_reading.before: The harvest verb is ethically neutral and receives moral content only from later plot details.
changed_reading.after: Within this surah's activated root field, the intended severance already casts a lexical shadow toward the later criminal category and its harvest remnants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model moves from intertwined plant abundance and measured apportionment to the water-overflow branch of transgression. It remains anchored in the focus garden, division, and cutting, plus the owners' later self-description, but downstream prose should mark the hydraulic analogy as exploratory rather than lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covered growth of جَنَّة is to be divided and severed through ق س م and ص ر م, creating a tension between living abundance and fixed measure.

activation_trace.role: Intertwined and forceful plant growth supplies abundance as a living process rather than a static stock.
Measured division into shares supplies the owners' attempt to fix the living surplus into bounded portions.
Severing supplies the operation by which flow and relation are terminated.
Planning by measure and estimation makes their claimed capacity an attempt to control the whole process.
Water rising beyond its limit supplies the owners' own image of transgression as overflow past a proper bound.

changed_reading.before: The owners competently measure and divide a fixed agricultural asset.
changed_reading.after: They try to arrest a living surplus into severed measures, while their own later confession activates transgression as overflow beyond the very limits they presume to control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus owners and the later companion of the fish share ص ح ب, while covered garden and bare open space form a spatial reversal. The model remains anchored through companionship, concealment, disclosure, fish, catching grace, and threatened exposure; prose should frame this as a comparative relation-pattern, not identify the two stories or erase their different outcomes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ binds people to a covered container, while later صَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ binds one person to another containing creature before threatened casting into the open.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and sustained association name the garden group's relation to its containing resource.
Covering and concealment supply the spatial condition attached to the garden companions.
Disclosure through trial makes movement from cover toward exposure interpretively active.
The repeated companion image establishes a second tested relation to a containing object.
The fish supplies the concrete second container to which the later companion is attached.
Catching up and reaching supplies grace's interruption before complete exposure.
Blessing supplies the beneficent agency that changes the later companion's outcome.
Casting away supplies the threatened movement out of containment.
Bare open space with no cover supplies the spatial opposite of the focus garden.

changed_reading.before: أَصْحَاب is a generic label for garden owners.
changed_reading.after: Companionship names a tested attachment to containment: one group loses the cover it controls, while another companion is nearly expelled into bare exposure but is caught by benefaction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The garden root's physical cover and the later disbelief root's covering of blessing create a striking cross-root activation. It remains anchored in the focus's covered orchard and benefaction branch, but prose should say the garden can conceal its gifted status from its owners, not derive an accusation solely from the shared English idea of covering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a covered orchard to ب ل و as possible benefaction, allowing later 'covering the blessing' to reactivate the owners' relation to the garden.

activation_trace.role: Physical covering and concealment supply the garden's spatial character.
Beautiful benefaction identifies the covered abundance as a received good rather than self-generated property.
Covering a blessing supplies the moralized concealment that the orchard's physical cover can activate.
A fruit sheath that covers produce keeps the activation materially inside the orchard domain.

changed_reading.before: The orchard's cover merely describes dense trees around a valuable asset.
changed_reading.after: The same cover can become epistemic and moral: dense benefit hides from its possessors the fact that the abundance is benefaction and therefore trial-bearing.

strongest_changes: The intended active dawn harvest reverses into the garden's already-completed cut-off or night-dark state, transferring agent, patient, and timing.
The oath changes from confidence into coalition discipline for withholding, then into an unauthorized claim to judge, bind, and author the future.
The garden's abundance is already the trial as benefaction; loss discloses the social relation formed around that good.
The planners of another's deprivation become the deprived, while their oath-bound companionship fragments into mutual blame.
The focus's severing economy is activated against reward that is not cut off, and against later lexical fields of criminal harvest remnants.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly returned the focus's own materials with altered roles: morning became a state rather than a schedule, cutting moved from intended act to received condition, companionship moved from coalition to fracture, and oath moved from reassurance to withholding, jurisdiction, and authorship. Split and cross-root branches also kept benefaction, wear, allotment, writing, harvest, cover, and exposure simultaneously live without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: صَرِيم can foreground night-like blackness, harvested barrenness, or general cutoff; the reversal is strong while its visual rendering should remain plural.

The dawn-raid, pen/lot/cut-land, hydraulic overflow, criminal-harvest, and covering-benefaction activations are packet-anchored but may be resource-level resonances rather than intended lexical networks.
The later oath, unseen-writing, delay, and fish-companion passages may illuminate the garden episode by surah-wide analogy rather than direct backward commentary.
The owners' confession and redirected desire show movement, but the packet does not establish completed repair or final acceptance.
